body:
Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ e2e00bff98f5619de04618b7ab733e1b3367c665

Verdict CLEAN

No findings.

Local trial merge with upstream/main was clean.
All five entry_ramp_angle pins passed.
cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main passed: 0 failures.
cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings passed.

Mutations: reverting the Contour angle fix made its pin RED (4.755 degrees). Reverting the shared descent angle fix made Circular, Bore and transition-entry pins RED (about 45 degrees). Both fixes were restored and all pins passed again.

Extra case: a legal 2 mm helix radius that cannot fit the Circular fixture fell back to a named ramp at no more than 3 degrees, in both cutting directions. The temporary pin was removed.

AGENTS checks passed: changed files are below 400 lines; no added production unwrap/expect/panic; no golden changes or prohibited file changes; body has Changelog: and Fixes #1674. Tracked tree is clean. Physical machining and full release gate were not run.

Fixed both requested findings at 2ff46f82157639266856e5deac3186a9705dc50b.

1. Inside Contour now keeps the link angle for explicit Ramp level transitions. Default entries still use 3 degrees. Pinned by `explicit_ramp_transition_keeps_its_own_link_angle` and `inside_contour_default_entry_ignores_steep_link_angle`.
2. Extended `explicit_ramp_transition_keeps_its_own_link_angle` to Inside Contour and Circular in both cutting directions.

Mutation check: reverting the production fix made the extended transition pin fail. Restoring it made all five `entry_ramp_angle` pins pass.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed with 0 failures. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Please re-review the new head. The PR remains a draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2ff46f82157639266856e5deac3186a9705dc50b -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The change affects Ramp moves that reach the posted G-code. No blocking items remain on this head.

The two items from the previous review are complete:
- Inside Contour keeps the link angle for an explicit Ramp level transition. Its default entry stays at 3 degrees.
- The transition test now checks Inside Contour and Circular in both cutting directions.

Local results, after a clean trial merge with `upstream/main` at `703af8185f7cfc574050d0187502b4b42d6b67eb`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --no-run` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed, 2 steps, 0 failed |
| motion library | 343 passed, 5 ignored |
| motion suites: `bore_ramp_angle`, `center_cut_law`, `circular_ramp_angle`, `contour_inside_ramp`, `entry_approach` | 2, 6, 2, 2, 9 passed |
| motion suites: `entry_ramp_angle`, `level_links`, `one_descent`, `predrilled_entry`, `xy_arc_entry` | 5, 12, 3, 6, 5 passed |
| app suites: `bore_entry`, `ladder_entry_height` | 4, 4 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

I repeated these mutation checks locally:
1. Restore `contour_bore.rs` from main: RED. The default entry and transition tests reject an entry at 4.755 degrees.
2. Restore `descent.rs` from main: RED. The Circular, Bore and transition tests reject entries at about 45 degrees.
3. Restore `contour_bore.rs` from the previous PR head: RED. The extended transition test detects the lost link angle.

Each mutation returned test exit code 101. I restored all files. All five `entry_ramp_angle` tests then passed. The tracked worktree has no changes after the local trial merge.

The default and explicit entry angles remain separate from the link angle in the changed paths. The shared helix fallback uses the recorded 3 degree default. The tests check ramp slopes, the final depth, and the named axial fallback at plunge feed.

No goldens changed, so there are no moved golden lines to check. No UI code changed, so before and after screenshots are not required. No scripts, workflows, build scripts, dependencies or process files changed. The new suite has a provenance line and a gate map. The decision file is present. The PR body has `Changelog:` and ends with `Fixes #1674`. The commit subjects follow the required format. No new production panic calls were added.

Requested before merge: none.

The full release gate and physical machining were not run. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
